description:
Analysis code accompanying Atia, Berson & Goldstein, Delivery and Attitude Modulate Shared Neural Processing of Speech Through Distinct Frequency Channels (Psychophysiology).

Frequency-resolved inter-subject correlation of magnetoencephalography during naturalistic speech: source reconstruction (MATLAB/FieldTrip), leave-one-out ISC by frequency band, low-level acoustic and visual feature control, separation of periodic from aperiodic activity, region-of-interest enrichment and against-zero tests, cross-study convergence, and the figures reported in the paper.

The data this code reads are deposited separately; see the related identifiers. Set ROOT in the scripts to the extracted data directory and every path resolves. The README gives the order the scripts run in.

MEG cleaning is upstream of this repository and is not included: it was done with cleanMEG_BIU (https://github.com/yuval-harpaz/cleanMEG_BIU), separately distributed under GPL v2.
